hints.title: Prefix Exploration Across Starting Points
hints.text: For each possible starting index i in text, explore consecutive ending indices j to determine whether substring text[i...j] matches any target word.

hints.title: Dictionary Lookup or Trie Walking
hints.text: Store the words in a prefix tree or fast lookup set to verify candidate substrings without redundant passes.

hints.title: Ordered Pair Collection
hints.text: Iterate i from 0 to n - 1 and j from i to n - 1. Whenever the substring is a target word, record [i, j]. Naturally maintains required sort order.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning each word across the full text independently requires O(W * N) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A lookup set or prefix tree identifies all matches starting at each index in quadratic text time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle string indexing cleanly and produce pairs sorted by start index then end index.
complexity.notes: N is up to 100, making quadratic string slicing extremely fast.
